options.reason: The table is evidently assembled for survival analysis of HNSCC: 480 homogeneous gene-expression features per tumour plus a death event indicator and months of follow-up. Model overall survival from expression, derive a TCGA-only risk score, then validate once on CPTAC with Kaplan-Meier and log-rank; survival status/months are the joint outcome and PatientID is a row key, not a feature.
options.title: survival
